readingFlow.title: Luận đề và bản đồ mô hình
readingFlow.lead: Dữ liệu nhiều chiều có thể có cấu trúc thấp chiều, nhưng phải nói rõ ta đang mô tả một linear subspace, một affine model hay một cloud chỉ nằm gần model đó.

blocks.text: Linear subspace là một closure contract. Affine model thêm offset mu. Near-subspace model thêm residual epsilon. Finite dataset chỉ là tập observations, không tự động là bất kỳ model set nào.

items.label: Linear subspace U
items.meaning: Contains zero and is closed under addition/scalar multiplication.

items.label: Affine model mu+U
items.meaning: Shifted model; need not contain origin.

items.label: Finite dataset D
items.meaning: Recorded observations; generally not closed under all linear combinations.

blocks.meaning: Separate reference point, represented component and unexplained component.
conditions: Feature order, units and model version are fixed
blocks.warning: epsilon is not automatically a fault label or Gaussian noise.

items: Are observations being confused with the model set?

readingFlow.title: Span, basis, dimension và rank
readingFlow.lead: Generators mô tả một set có thể biểu diễn. Rank nói trong số generators đó có bao nhiêu directions thực sự độc lập.

blocks.meaning: Column space is the exact representable set.
conditions: Columns share one ambient coordinate system
blocks.warning: k columns do not imply k-dimensional subspace.

blocks.meaning: Dimension equals the number of independent column directions.
conditions: Exact or numerical rank is stated
blocks.warning: Do not equate sensor count or feature count with independent information.

blocks.title: Redundant generators
blocks.text: For g3=g1+g2, the three-column matrix still has rank 2 and spans the same space as (g1,g2).
In engineering data, an additional sensor may increase columns without increasing rank if it repeats an existing linear direction.

readingFlow.title: Centering và affine model
readingFlow.lead: Projection onto U is meaningful for the centred vector y=x-mu, not blindly for the raw observation x when the model is affine.

blocks.text: Subtract the locked reference mean: y=x-mu.

items.label: Vector normalization
items.meaning: Rescale one observation, often to unit norm.

blocks.meaning: Project in centred coordinates, then add the affine offset back for raw-space reconstruction.
conditions: mu and P_U belong to the same model version
blocks.warning: QQ^Tx silently ignores the affine offset.

items: Was the same mu used at training and scoring?

readingFlow.title: Projector từ orthonormal basis
readingFlow.lead: When Q has orthonormal columns, dot products isolate coordinates and the projector takes the compact form QQ^T.

blocks.text: Verify Q^TQ=I_k under a declared tolerance before using the shortcut.

steps: Substitute into y_hat to get y_hat=QQ^Ty

blocks.meaning: Coordinates in the orthonormal basis Q.
blocks.warning: Do not reuse this formula for arbitrary B.
P_U is usually singular when k<n; that is expected.

readingFlow.title: Projector từ general basis
readingFlow.lead: A basis may span the correct subspace without being orthonormal. In that case the Gram matrix corrects for basis geometry.

blocks.text: BB^T is not the general orthogonal projector. It is valid only when the columns are orthonormal.
B must have full column rank for B^TB to be invertible.
The locked general basis B spans the same U as Q. Its coordinates (0.4,-0.2) differ from Q-coordinates (0.6,-0.2), while both reconstruct the same projected vector.

readingFlow.title: Projector invariants và residual
readingFlow.lead: A projection result is trustworthy only when the operator and the decomposition pass their invariants.

blocks.meaning: Symmetry distinguishes orthogonal projection; idempotence means projecting twice changes nothing.
Split centred observation into explained and unexplained components.
conditions: P_U belongs to the same model contract
blocks.warning: r is not automatically sensor noise.

blocks.meaning: Residual is orthogonal to the model subspace.

readingFlow.title: Hợp đồng case bốn cảm biến
readingFlow.lead: The locked case is not just a matrix exercise. It is a versioned feature and operating-regime contract.

blocks.text: x in R^4 contains four calibrated fixed-window RMS acceleration features in order A,B,C,D.
Units are m/s^2 RMS; the model covers one normal operating regime; channel order and preprocessing are fixed.

blocks.warning: Direction labels are teaching interpretations, not proven causal physical modes.

blocks.text: Reordering x without reordering mu, Q and all model artifacts produces shape-correct but semantically invalid scores.

readingFlow.title: Worked normal sample
readingFlow.lead: The normal sample demonstrates the complete affine-projection pipeline and its interpretation boundary.

blocks.text: Permitted: well represented by the current teaching model. Prohibited: proven healthy.

readingFlow.title: Worked mismatch sample và giới hạn score
readingFlow.lead: A high residual score is evidence that the current model explains the observation poorly. It is not a diagnosis engine.

blocks.text: Possible explanations include a new regime, transient, calibration drift, sensor issue, outlier or underspecified model. The score alone selects none of them.

items.label: Residual norm
items.meaning: Compresses mismatch to one magnitude and loses direction.

readingFlow.title: Numerical rank, SVD và retained energy
readingFlow.lead: Rank statements answer different questions depending on exact algebra, numerical tolerance and representation objective.

blocks.meaning: Count singular values above a declared tolerance.
blocks.warning: Software default is not a physical mode detector.

blocks.text: Locked X_c has singular values (1.44955817,0.77504298,0.03505112,0.00330126). All are nonzero, so the stored matrix has floating-point rank 4. Under tau=0.05, numerical rank is 2.

blocks.meaning: Reduced SVD organizes matrix directions and magnitudes.
conditions: X_c is 8x4 with samples as rows

blocks.meaning: Two directions retain nearly all squared singular-value energy of this locked centred matrix.
blocks.warning: This is not prediction accuracy, fault coverage or causal validation.

readingFlow.title: Implementation contract và troubleshooting
readingFlow.lead: A correct formula can still produce an invalid engineering result when shape, feature semantics, centering or tolerance are hidden.

items.label: Numerical error
items.meaning: Unstable computation, hidden tolerance or conditioning.

items.label: Data-contract error
items.meaning: Wrong channel order, units, regime or preprocessing.

items.label: Interpretation error
items.meaning: Model-fit evidence turned into causal claim.

blocks.text: A script that reproduces one expected scalar can still be wrong if it silently permutes features or projects uncentred data.
Production code should version mu, Q, feature schema, scale, regime and threshold together rather than shipping naked arrays.

readingFlow.title: Bridge sang data matrix và mastery close
readingFlow.lead: One observation can be projected against a model. Many compatible observations require a data matrix to expose shared structure.

blocks.meaning: Eight centred observations as rows, four sensor features as columns.
conditions: Same feature order, units and preprocessing
blocks.warning: X_c^T answers questions in a different space.

blocks.text: §1.6 takes over the matrix-level questions: how rows and columns encode observations/features, how transformations act, and how rank and SVD connect to matrix structure.

items: Interpret residual and energy within limits
Can you reproduce both locked samples?
Can you explain rank 4 versus rank_tau 2?
Can you state what score and rho_k do not prove?
